in_sanskrit.name: दिलीप्सिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dilipsinh is derived from Sanskrit words 'दिल' (dil) meaning 'beloved, dear' and 'सिंह' (singh) meaning 'lion'. Thus, the name Dilipsinh can be translated to 'beloved lion' or 'dear lord'.

in_hindi.name: दिलीप्सिंह
in_hindi.meaning: दिल (dil) का पुत्रा साझा हुआ सिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Dilipsinh is derived from the Hindi words 'दिल' (dil) meaning 'heart, mind, emotion' and 'सिंह' (singh) meaning 'lion'. Thus, the name Dilipsinh can be translated to 'son of the heart, mind, or emotion, lion'.

in_tamil.name: திலிப்பிஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Dilipsinh in Tamil is written as திலிப்பிஷ். The name is derived from the Tamil words 'இலவ்ருத்த' (ilavruttam) meaning 'beloved, dear' and 'வளர்வான' (valarvan) meaning 'lord'. Thus, the name Dilipsinh in Tamil can be translated to 'beloved lord'.

in_telugu.name: దిలీప్పిశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Dilipsinh in Telugu is written as దిలీప్పిశ్. The name is derived from the Telugu words 'దేశి' (desi) meaning 'beloved, dear' and 'యేశ్వర' (yesvar) meaning 'lord'. Thus, the name Dilipsinh in Telugu can be translated to 'beloved lord'.

in_marathi.name: Dilipsinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (righteousness) and Lion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dilipsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dilipsinh is derived from Sanskrit roots. Dili (दिलि) means 'Dharma' or 'righteousness'. Sinh (सिंह) means 'Lion'. This name represents the brave and just ruler, embodying the strength and courage of a lion and the wisdom and virtuousness of dharma.
